channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Judge extends block on Trump White House ban of MS NOW, CNN and Politico
item.description: President Donald Trump had sought to ban media outlets MS NOW, CNN and Politico from reporting from the White House.

item.title: Oil rises amid growing Mideast tensions between Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia
item.description: Worries over supply disruptions due to escalating tensions in the Middle East helped to push oil prices higher.

item.title: Taiwan agrees to buy 30% of gas from Alaska LNG project, Trump says
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said Tuesday that Taiwan had agreed to buy 30% of the gas from a pipeline project in Alaska.

item.title: Stock futures are little changed as traders await consumer inflation report: Live updates
item.description: A slide in chip stocks and mixed bank results on Tuesday weighed on the major averages.

item.title: FBI arrests Saudi OpenAI employee who allegedly planted recording device in conference room
item.description: The Tuesday incident comes as the ChatGPT-maker, along with competitors, faces heightened scrutiny over its safety practices.

item.title: China's producer prices rise at fastest pace since June 2022, beating expectations
item.description: The increase was higher than the 4.5% expected by economists polled by Reuters, and higher than the 3.8% seen in the previous month.

item.title: Mastercard is up 8 days in a row. The charts indicate the run isn't over
item.description: Mastercard shares have been on a tear. The stock is up eight days in a row and is just now ticking to an all-time high.

item.title: 'Godzilla El Niño' is wreaking havoc with Philippine central bank's inflation forecasts
item.description: The Philippine central bank is running policy scenarios for a severe El Niño on top of the oil shock, with inflation at a three-year high.

item.title: South Korean carmaker Hyundai plans 'strategic' investment of $15.5 billion in India by 2032
item.description: Korean car company Hyundai says India is a strategic core market

item.title: Crypto bosses, CEOs and F1: Singapore's business events boom gathers pace
item.description: Singapore's Formula 1 race week is a major business draw as a growing number of conferences coincide with the Grand Prix.

item.title: French supermarket fridges get hacked, heating to 122°F and sparking fires
item.description: Hackers targeted hundreds of French supermarkets in a large-scale cyberattack, causing refrigerators to overheat, spoiling food, and sparking fires.

item.title: In charts: How one of the world's biggest economies got trapped by debt
item.description: France opens debate on its 2027 budget as high deficits, rising debt and student protests intensify pressure on lawmakers.

item.title: Here's where Jim Cramer stands on this newly public AI infrastructure stock
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors should hold off on buying newly public AI infrastructure company Accelevation Holdings.

item.title: Wednesday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
item.description: The S&P 500 inched lower as traders mulled over the latest quarterly results from big banks. Tune in to CNBC on Wednesday for Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon.

item.title: Trump's diesel deal with Russia equals less than two weeks of U.S. demand
item.description: President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia comes as he is under pressure to reduce fuel prices with the U.S. midterm elections less than a month way.

item.title: More Republicans come out against Trump's diesel deal with Putin
item.description: Senators told Trump, the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin "will not achieve just ends, nor will it benefit Americans."

item.title: I was one of the biggest shareholders in this tech stock in the 1990s. I'm bullish again because of AI
item.description: Flex plans to spin off Axiom, its AI infrastructure business, in 2027. Paul Meeks sees upside as data center power demand grows.

item.title: Bank of America fined $1.2 billion over money-laundering violations
item.description: The action by the Treasury Department was announced less than a day before Bank of America reports quarterly earnings.

item.title: China's exports and imports surge past expectations in September
item.description: The country's customs agency released September trade data on Wednesday.

item.title: Anthropic urges court in Washington, D.C. to rehear appeal of Pentagon blacklisting
item.description: Anthropic is asking a federal court in Washington, D.C. to rehear its appeal in a case concerning the Pentagon's blacklisting of the company's AI models.

item.title: We're upgrading our rating on Wells Fargo as the stock's pullback offers a nice entry point
item.description: Wells Fargo's third-quarter results were not perfect, but CEO Charlie Scharf's turnaround should bear more fruit ahead.

item.title: CNBC Points Pro: How to book a flight to South Africa with points
item.description: Points expert Jason Stauffer explains how to use points and miles to fly from New York City to South Africa.

item.title: Singapore third-quarter GDP growth softens from four-year high but beats estimates
item.description: The GDP print beat expectations of a 5% growth from economists polled by Reuters.

item.title: Goldman says investors are looking for 'profitable' Chinese business growth overseas
item.description: Sluggish consumer demand in China has pushed many companies, such as electric car brands, to accelerate plans for entering other countries.

item.title: The latest inflation data is expected to show price increases are accelerating
item.description: Economists expect the consumer price index for September to rise 0.6% on the month and 3.6% year over year.

item.title: Judge says Musk engaged in intimidation of ex-FEMA CFO Mary Comans, clears her name
item.description: Ex-FEMA CFO Mary Comans' name was cleared by a federal judge after Elon Musk and other government officials falsely accused her of criminal actions in 2025.

item.title: Pope Leo diagnosed with cancer as doctors remove lobe of lung, Vatican says
item.description: Pope Leo was diagnosed with lung cancer after a lower lobe of the Pope's right lung was removed in a curative surgery, the Vatican said.

item.title: Don't let inflation bite — how to hedge with TIPS, commodities and infrastructure funds
item.description: TIPS are looking attractive but they aren't the only way to get inflation protection.

item.title: Six Flags shares decline following deadly roller coaster incident
item.description: One person died and several others were injured in an incident involving the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia, according to reports.

item.title: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents like Muse, Instinct from directly accessing accounts
item.description: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon warned of rogue agents operating at scale and said the bank is building defensive tools.
